title: Chintamani Library v2.3.0 (Build 33) — Portal 8-Card Luxury Redesign, Vignette Art & Multi-Identifier Attendance
releaseNotes: Ultra-Fast Resumable Downloads: Enabled HTTP Range requests, stream resuming, and eliminated the 45s receive timeout so downloads never stall or get interrupted
High-Speed Architecture-Specific Downloads: Automatic arm64-v8a package detection cuts download size from 85 MB to 35 MB (more than 2.4x faster!)
Rebranded Universal QR Portal: Standardized all branding from 'Chintamani' to 'Chintamani Library' across headers, titles, cards, and modal sheets

Reorganized Universal QR Portal Services: Replaced old layout with an 8-card luxury grid (Attendance, UPI Payments, New Registration, Feedback & Reviews, Complaint & Support, Membership Status, Live Seat Matrix, Help & Director Hotline)
Glassmorphism + Multicolour 3D Styling: Every service card is themed with distinct vibrant accents (Emerald, Gold, Amber, Rose, Ruby, Purple, Cyan, Blue) and smooth hover/press scale animations
Card Image Vignette & Opacity: Incorporated authentic high-resolution library images into every single portal card with radial and linear dark gradient vignettes
Multi-Identifier Attendance: Member attendance can now be verified and checked in using Mobile Number, Full Name, OR Member ID (any of these three)

Fixed Attendance Detail Fetching: Resolved issue where unverified or failed lookups previously generated placeholder check-in cards; portal now strictly displays verified real-time records and actionable alert feedback
Streamlined Mobile Universal QR Screen: Removed the redundant attendance card from below the Universal QR code card in the app, standardizing all screens to 'CHINTAMANI LIBRARY'
